name: Joel McConaughy
headline: NetSuite Certified SuiteCommerce Advanced Developer
about:
Highlights of my SCA experience:

• Working with SuiteCommerce Advanced since the original beta version was released in August 2013. 
• Received Suite Commerce Advanced Certified Developer status in January 2016.
• As an individual or team lead, implemented 30 sites, at least one on every released version of SCA. 
• Provide ongoing support and enhancements to an additional 25 SCA sites, many of these developed originally by NetSuite Professional Services.
• Experience with the Quick Start version of SCA used by NetSuite Professional Services.
• Manage a team of certified NetSuite developers focused solely on SCA implementations. 
• Experience implementing large, multi-site, and international sites.
• Experience with general e-commerce operations and management.

Hands-on technical leader for web-based systems development and operations with a driven curiosity about all things web. Comfortable with both large and small-scale development having managed 50+ developer teams and having developed entire web applications individually. Works effectively in ambiguous situations and can help bring structure and professionalism to young or struggling organizations. Excellent analytical, communication and execution skills.
… more

experiences.description: Provide contract development services and support for the NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced platform.

Designed and implemented floodbuddy.com and the supporting CRM system to automate the process of quoting and selling of FEMA-backed flood insurance.

• Web applications built using Java/PostgreSQL/Apache Cocoon/jQuery/Bootstrap/Backbone.
• Real-time integration with 3rd party services for flood zone determination, address verification, policy quoting and issuing, payment.
• Sophisticated Google Analytics and Google Ad Words implementation to support rapid A/B testing and micro-targeting to the local level.

Provide planning, implementation and maintenance for Netsuite-based e-commerce sites thosbaker.com and sevengametables.com.  Recent accomplishments:

• Dynamic item faceting that overrides Netsuite page size limitations: goo.gl/hpFhwE.
• Sophisticated email registration pop-up with exit intent triggering and lead source tracking. 
• Structured data mark-up for all products and categories to support improved SEO results.
• Completed Netsuite SuiteCommerce Advanced: Building & Customizing Webstore certification course.

Web Developer, Bazomb Inc., San Luis Obispo, CA, October 2009 – current. 
Provide web site development and ongoing support for a daily deals site. Java/PostgreSQL/Apache Cocoon. 
http://bazomb.com

CTO, Migratory Music LLC, Los Angeles, CA, July 2010 – May 2012. 
Designed and developed a secure digital download music station for iPhone and iPod. Java/MySQL/Lucene/Adobe Flex/C#.NET. 
http://migratorymusic.com

Kiosk Developer, NV3 Technologies, Baltimore, MD, March 2012 – February 2013. 
Developed a digital download and cell phone charging kiosk for iPhone and iPod. LAMP stack. 
http://nv3tech.com

Web Developer, Adrenaline Adventures, Seattle WA, Aug 2012 – Oct 2012.
Developed Shopify-based e-commerce site using Liquid templates.
http://adrenaline-adventures.com   

Contract CTO and software development services for consumer and enterprise websites.  

• Expert Java developer 10+ years.
• Expert web services developer:  REST, JSON.
• Expert Front End Developer: Responsive design, jQuery, Bootstrap, Backbone.
• Proficient .NET and RoR developer 2 years.
• Deployment to cloud providers Amazon Web Services and Google Apps.
• E-commerce implementations using Payflow Pro and Shopify.

Implement data visualization tools for the 787 quality visibility team and mentor staff on software engineering best practices.

• Built applications using ASP.NET/MVC 4/SQL Server/jQuery/Backbone and Adobe Flash Builder/Flex/Teradata/MS Access
• Created ETL/SQL scripts for Teradata, SQL Server, MS Access
• Experience with Velocity and underlying data model

CD Baby is the world’s largest distributor of independent music.  Reporting to the CEO as a contract VP of Technology.  Created a new division for eBook distribution and launched BookBaby.com in conjunction with the Apple iPad launch.

Founded Displayware in January, 2004 to develop in-store digital merchandising systems for traditional retailers.  Conceived and designed an integrated system of digital kiosks, overhead video displays, and enterprise management software that help retailers sell complex products such as consumer electronics, appliances and entertainment media.  Responsible for all corporate activities including sales, development, operations and financing.

The Port of Seattle owns and operates Sea-Tac International Airport and the cargo and passenger shipping terminals in and around Seattle. Provided interim leadership to a 40-person IT team including budgeting, business continuity planning and staffing during an executive search for a permanent CIO.

Loudeye Corporation provided corporate webcasting and digital media and entertainment services to Fortune 500 companies. Responsible for managing a 60- person team that delivered a full-service webcasting platform, a large-scale encoding and hosting facility and an online music library containing over 300,000 albums.

Intertainer was a nationwide broadband media distributor that delivers the largest selection of movies, music videos, television and shopping on-demand to your PC or TV. Responsible for full lifecycle software development of Internet and digital cable platforms, on-going operations including deployment, help desk, and network operations, and administration of a 50 person engineering staff.
